value.name: visit house after funeral
value.description: A week after Rosa's funeral, the Serrano family house is shown as recently emptied and still marked by her presence.
evidence: A week after the funeral, the Serrano row house on Spruce still smelled faintly of the eucalyptus oil the matriarch had rubbed into her wrists each morning, and the kitchen calendar was turned to a month she had not lived to see.

value.name: Asha enters with executor key
value.description: Asha lets herself into the house using the key provided by the executor and heads upstairs to search Rosa's room.
evidence: Asha let herself in with the key the executor had given her and went straight upstairs, past the front parlor where buyers had already walked through twice, toward the narrow back bedroom where Rosa had slept the last two years.

value.name: Asha searches Rosa's bedroom
value.description: Asha carefully searches the bedroom for a hidden codicil or other important document.
evidence: She moved carefully there, opening the nightstand, lifting the folded altar cloth from the top of the dresser, checking the underside of a framed photograph for anything tucked behind the backing; if a codicil existed, this was the room a woman would hide it in for the daughter-in-law who had stayed.

value.name: Daniel searches mother's desk
value.description: Daniel methodically empties his mother's writing desk and inspects it for hidden papers.
evidence: Down the hall, Daniel was already at his mother's writing desk, pulling each drawer fully out and turning it over, sliding a hand along the empty runners and then under the desk itself, working with the brisk competence of a man who did not want to be doing this slowly.

value.name: Daniel finds ordinary papers only
value.description: Daniel discovers routine documents but no message or bequest addressed to him.
evidence: He found insurance receipts, a Mass card, a rubber-banded stack of unopened bank statements, and nothing in his mother's hand addressed to him.

value.name: Daniel resents Asha's search
value.description: When Daniel hears Asha upstairs in Rosa's part of the house, he feels a quiet refusal and does not ask what she is doing.
evidence: When he heard Asha's step overhead, in Rosa's part of the house, he did not call up to ask what she was looking for, and the small refusal settled in him before he could name it.

value.name: Asha approaches Daniel
value.description: Asha comes down the hall toward Daniel, stopping at a careful distance before speaking or acting further.
